claims.description: Repeated guardian-attachment attempts from one Cloudflare source share a 30-attempt, 10-minute window and a different source remains independent.
Rotating X-Forwarded-For suffixes retain the leftmost originating-client bucket.
Initiation and redemption requests with varied authority tokens and charge IDs share the same source bucket.
Below-limit requests preserve success and typed forbidden behavior.
The first over-limit request returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After 600 before verifier or attachment service work.
Unknown requests collapse to one bounded source bucket; shared limiter tests verify the configured max-entry LRU contract.
